concepts.direction: Single 240px light sidebar, one uninterrupted clean vertical hierarchy. Brand home row at top y20. Immediately below at y68 put an understated white bordered full-width 新建会话 button with blue small plus at left, no filled blue slab. Then at y116 two stacked restrained navigation rows 会话 and 插件, selected 插件 has very pale blue background and blue icon/text. A single fine divider at y204. Below y224 combine 最近会话 header with count 4 on right, then search input at y248, then four 36px recent rows at y296+. Let history occupy the stretch middle. Bottom y632 one compact non-button identity row with small outline avatar, 访客空间 and green dot, subtitle 授权至 11:30. 官网 link belongs to the same footer row on far right, no separate tall block. Align all icon centers x28 and text starts x52 consistently. Calm practical precise desktop productivity software.
concepts.strength: 新建和导航顺序清楚，单列浏览最直接。
concepts.tradeoff: 沿用单列结构，变化较克制。

concepts.title: 空间优先
concepts.direction: Single total240px sidebar with a workspace-first hierarchy and horizontal segmented navigation, distinctly different from A and B. Brand logo32px and 道引 Harness at x16 y24. Under brand at y70 a flat compact identity region: 访客空间 green dot, 12px subtitle 授权至 11:30, small outline avatar at left; no box, no switcher arrow because account switching not implemented. At y138 full-width two-segment navigation 会话 | 插件 each104px width36px high; 插件 selected white on light#edf2ff segmented track with blue text. At y198 最近会话 16px header on left and a compact plus with full label 新建会话 13px action aligned right, BOTH fit in216px using small12px header if necessary. Under at y230 a 搜索会话 thin search field. Four recent rows starting y282 with all13px text and36px row height. No massive full-width blue CTA. Large flexible history region. At bottom only a very compact 官网 ↗ link aligned x16 y678 with subtle horizontal hairline; identity stays at TOP. Thoughtful editorial grouping, clean fine dividers, blue only for active state, exact same typography and radius family as main panel.
concepts.strength: 空间信息集中在顶部，会话区更连贯。
concepts.tradeoff: 新建入口较轻，视觉上不如 A 突出。
